newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Orient-Avia launches Thai, UAE charters.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Orient-Avia launches Thai, UAE charters.

text.p: Private Russian airline ZAO Orient-Avia will begin passenger charter flights from Moscow to Bangkok and Dubai later this month, a company spokeswoman said on Friday.

Yevgenia Semeryakova told Reuters the company would launch Moscow-Bangkok flights from December 23 operating Ilyushin-62 jets on Mondays and Moscow-Dubai charters from December 28 operating Ilyushin-86s on Saturdays.

The Moscow-based Orient-Avia, established in 1994, operates Ilyushin-62M and Ilyushin-86 jets on regular long-range routes between Moscow and Vladivostok and Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky in the Russian Far East. The company also makes charters from Moscow to Hurghada in Egypt and from Vladivostok to U Taphao in Thailand.
The company's two Tupolev-134 short range planes service short routes, including flights between Moscow and Kaunas in Lithuania.
In 1995 Orient-Avia carried 100,000 passengers and 450 tonnes of cargo. --Viktor Anoshkin, Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
